name: Lumen
tagline: Declarative, markup-first UI framework for native desktop apps.
description: Author a .lmn markup tree, a CSS-subset stylesheet, and an optional script; lumenc compiles them to a layout IR and runs it on a two-world ECS core with GPU rendering and hot reload that preserves state across a swap.

name: LocusMath
tagline: Competitive math platform with ELO-based ranking.
description: Practice algebra, calculus, and linear algebra against generated problems graded by a computer algebra system. Instant feedback and a competitive ELO ladder.

name: Drift
tagline: Lightweight 2D game engine in C++20 with a Bevy-inspired ECS.
description: Component-based 2D engine built on flecs, with SDL3 GPU rendering, Box2D physics, a plugin architecture, parallel scheduling, particle systems, sprite animation, and Aseprite/Tiled asset import.

name: Chessus
tagline: High-performance chess engine with neural-network evaluation.
description: Bitboard move generation, NNUE evaluation, and multi-threaded search with null-move pruning and late move reductions. Speaks UCI, with a PyTorch training pipeline for self-play data and network tuning.

name: Tensor-Frame
tagline: PyTorch-like tensor library for Rust with multiple backends.
description: GPU-accelerated numerical computing for Rust. CPU (Rayon), WGPU (Metal/Vulkan/DX12), and CUDA backends with automatic selection and fallback, NumPy/PyTorch-style broadcasting, and zero-copy operations.

name: bevy_ufbx
tagline: FBX asset loader for Bevy, powered by ufbx.
description: Imports FBX models into Bevy: triangle meshes with normals and UVs, PBR materials, skeletal skinning, scene hierarchies, and lights. Configurable import settings and support across Bevy 0.17 to 0.19.

name: symengine.js
tagline: WebAssembly build of SymEngine, a fast symbolic math library.
description: Symbolic computation in the browser: expression manipulation, differentiation, trig, and number theory, with code generation to C, JavaScript, LaTeX, and MathML. A clean JS/TS API over SymEngine's C++ engine compiled to WASM.

name: FastIO
tagline: Fast Java I/O for competitive programming.
description: Lightweight buffered input/output built for contests like USACO. Simple, clean API so the I/O layer stays out of the way while you solve the problem.
